PTC dispatch arrives a"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s `tool/ptc-dispatch(-start)`; the retired `tool/code-dispatch(-start)` spelling is still matched so"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" a session recorded before that rename keeps its card. Older kernels are NOT supported by this versi"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"on — install `dsh-diff-stat@0.1.8` (or an older release that covers them) on those kernels
- **Inlin"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"e +N −M badges** — takes over the stock mutation rows for `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` ("},{"id":"p8s8","text":"`str_replace_editor` is opt-in, off by default; keyed lower-priority shadow; uninstall restores stoc"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"k).
